messages:
maria: opened a compact 'Quota scenarios playbook' PR under /docs/usage to consolidate common customer Q&A. needs: tiny SDK snippets (py+js), a dashboard panel example, a 3-row scenario table, and two link fixes. hoping for reviews before docs freeze tonight.
ashley: dropping by to review after stand. can you paste the PR link?
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 - also docs-ci found a broken anchor on billing -> quota headers.
sam: i can do the SDK snippets. prefer minimal, copy-paste friendly. will include handling for 429 and reading X-Quota-Remaining header.
leo: prefer a small table instead of long text: situation | response | recommended client action. 3 example rows: steady usage, burst, sustained throttle.
ben: add a short note about burst credits expiring end-of-month and that dashboard shows "remaining allowance" separately from quota. customers miss this.
ashley: editorial: change heading from "Quota behavior" to "Quota & rate-limit behavior" so TOC is clearer. also call out units: tokens vs compute units.
sam: draft JS snippet:
```js
// JS SDK - check quota quickly
const res = await client.get('/quota');
if (res.status === 200) console.log('remaining:', res.data.remaining, 'units');
else if (res.status === 429) console.warn('rate limited, retry-after:', res.headers['x-retry-after']);
```

and Python:
```py
# Python SDK - check quota
res = client.get('/quota')
if res.status_code == 200:
    print('remaining:', res.json().get('remaining'), 'units')
elif res.status_code == 429:
    print('rate limited, retry after:', res.headers.get('Retry-After'))
```

leo: nice and short. can we add a one-line fallback pattern showing how to switch to a cheaper model on 429? pseudocode ok.
sam: added fallback example: `if 429: client.generate(model='small-quantized')`
maria: docs-ci can you re-run linkcheck after i push edits? failing anchor was billing#quota-headers.
docs-ci: link checker: 1 failed anchor (billing#quota-headers). re-run scheduled on push to branch docs/pr-492.
ben: for dashboard section please include a placeholder image and a short caption: "Remaining allowance panel: shows burst credits + monthly quota". mark TODO to replace with real screenshot.
ashley: also add a small clarifying paragraph on "how to interpret quota vs meter usage". customers conflate them. keep it 2 lines.
maria: i'll push updates in ~8m with the table, snippets, heading change, and screenshot placeholder. tagging for review.
sam: will squash & add a one-line changelog entry for release notes after CI passes.
leo: no eng signoff needed for docs-only changes, but ping eng-ml if we mention model names/variants.
maria: thanks everyone. pushing now. :thumbsup:
